If you're raising a daughter, teach her before the world does. ☂️ Confidence is easier to build than to repair.

Nora is five. Her dad tells her, "The world will rain on you one day. Let's get you ready." And year by year, he builds her umbrella:
☂️ Age 6: Her body is hers. She doesn't have to hug anyone.
☂️ Age 8: Boundaries aren't rude. "No, thanks."
☂️ Age 11: Not everything goes online. 📱
☂️ Age 12: She is enough, no matter how many likes.
☂️ Age 13: Watch how friends make her feel.
☂️ Age 15: Love should never make her afraid. "Who were you talking to?!" Nora walks away.
☂️ Trust her instincts, even when she can't explain why.

CDC data shows about 1 in 12 high schoolers who date experience physical dating violence. 💔

At sixteen, a text at midnight: "Can you come get me?" Dad: "On my way. No lecture tonight." 🚗 Home always feels safe.

"There is no fear in love, but perfect love casts out fear." 1 John 4:18 (ESV) 🙏

Nora learned what real love looks like at home, so she recognizes it, and the fake kind, out there. ❤️ Home teaches her who she is.

✨ Simple anxiety skills
📖 Scripture they can hold onto
